effects.name: Steven Knott
effects.why: 诺特是按日雇人的房东，不是打手，按普通成年人记他的体格。

background: He stayed in the rented office after Hayes left, waiting on the day's first report and watching the clock.
reports: Nothing new has come in about the house or the Macarios since the morning briefing.
open_threads: He still expects a report before the day is wasted.

action.goal: 投住诺特的领子打一拳，逼他说清科比特宅里死过谁
action.method: 用双手擘住领口后直接用拳头打过去
action.stakes: 打不中会把雇主彻底得罪，这份差事当场吹了

effects.name: Steven Knott
effects.why: 他是房东不是打手，被人揪领子后只想脱身，不想还手。

effects.name: Steven Knott
effects.why: 海斯刚动手打他，差事还在，信任没了。

action.goal: 他不还手，这一架停在桌边
action.method: 退到桌后，把拳头挡开，不再打

match.baseline: resolve combat:end vs 托马斯·海斯
